name: Boneshatter Juggernaut
summary: League-start melee build. Boneshatter trades a little life for stacks, so the gear is armour and resistances, the axe is a rare with attack speed, and the ascendancy makes the trauma survivable. Herald of Purity and Vulnerability turn the axe into damage, and no unique is required, which is what a strength build needs on day one of a solo league.

pros.text: Very tanky: armour, endurance charges and Juggernaut damage reduction.
No required unique; a rare two-handed axe is the whole damage slot.
Strong single-target once trauma stacks are running.
Cheap to gear because accuracy is solved by Resolute Technique.
Trauma scaling rewards staying in the fight.
A comfortable lab runner for the first two labyrinths.

cons.text: Trauma hurts you; mistakes and long fights tax your own life.
Melee range means you eat mechanics a ranged build can walk away from.
Attack speed is both damage and survival, so slow weapons feel bad.
Clear speed is slower than a bow or a minion build.
Mana is tight before leech and reduced cost are solved.
Resolute Technique gives up critical strikes entirely.

swaps.note: Sunder clears packs and hits single targets harder than Cleave until Boneshatter unlocks.

notes: First guide for the Covens league.
The two-handed gear profile no longer inherits a shield; armour rolls and a chaos belt raise life, EHP and max hit at every map checkpoint.
Weapon-scoped tree targets stop points going to one-hand and mace-crit notables under Resolute Technique.
Herald of Purity, Vulnerability, Added Fire Damage and a Silver Flask raise measured DPS across the leveling and map steps; re-rated S+.
The weapon carries mana leech so the Herald of Purity and Determination reservation is playable; CWDT stays level 5 and the triggered gems are capped to it.
A mana flask covers the 28-67 stretch before the rare axe can carry leech; the gate report now publishes unreserved mana and mana cost at every step.
Small armour slots use the glove/boot armour scale and a Leather Belt; the Melee Splash swap is part of the maps-red plan, not a hidden rating claim.
The leveling filter hides Chain Belts and normal/magic Paua Rings; rare Paua Rings still show, because a rare can roll life and resists.
Step plans stop recommending crit multi on a Resolute Technique build and stop calling the 5-link a 6-link.

Physical damage is the whole build: upgrade the weapon whenever a higher-DPS base drops.

crafting.note: Bench physical damage % on a free prefix.

lookFor.note: The 5-link is enough for the campaign; do not pay for a 6-link yet.

Reach 3,000 life, cap resistances and fit Herald of Purity with Determination.

crafting.note: Bench attack speed if the weapon has a free suffix.

Herald of Purity is the damage aura and a level-capped Vulnerability rides on Cast when Damage Taken.
Swap Close Combat for Melee Splash on pack-heavy maps; keep Close Combat for bosses.

lookFor.note: Upgrade the weapon before the jewellery; mana leech keeps the reservation playable.
6-link is the red-map gate; armour is the other half of max hit.
Life is the defence; armour is the mitigation.

goals: Cap chaos resistance at 75% and reach 7,000 life.
Keep Herald of Purity and Vulnerability up; the measured pinnacle uses 21/20 gems, and 20/20 is the budget version.

summary.text: Boneshatter Juggernaut is a two-handed melee build that measures 501.2k at red maps and 830.2k at pinnacle. The rare axe, armour rolls and Herald of Purity carry the damage, the ascendancy makes the trauma survivable, and no unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with Cleave and Added Fire Damage until Sunder is available, then use Sunder until Boneshatter unlocks and switch to the two-handed axe. The first checkpoint measures 425 life and 41 damage; the second measures 1.0k with a self-cast Vulnerability. The mana flask covers you until the rare axe carries leech; the Silver Flask comes with that axe.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 501.2k damage, 31123 effective life and 12506 physical max hit. Herald of Purity is the damage aura and a level-capped Vulnerability rides on Cast when Damage Taken; the axe's mana leech keeps the quarter-full mana bar up. Cap the elemental resistances, keep the axe current, and swap Close Combat for Melee Splash when you want faster packs.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 830.2k damage with 41042 effective life and 15700 physical max hit. Use Enduring Cry before the burst, keep Vulnerability up, and keep the trauma stacks running while you move out of the biggest slams.
